entry.title: OP3000 1.0.1
entry.summary: Delay Mix is now Delay Send. Echoes that have already started keep ringing after you turn the send down. On the third page, the old delay-tone fader is a second send. Delay tone is on a Q-Link. The folder name and the plugin id are the same, so replace the Stampman3000 - VST - OP3000 folder and restart.

entry.title: OP3000 1.0.0
entry.summary: OP3000 1.0.0 for MPC OS 3.x. The armv7 zip is Gen1. The aarch64 zip is Gen2. op3000-1.0.0-mpc.zip is the Akai SDK folder.
